HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.
   C. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.

2. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   B. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.
   D. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)

   A. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations up to 19th Century.

   D. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

10. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Destroying road signs

11. Which statement about Linguistic groups in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

12. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

16. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely
